translationRepairs: Taizu was called Hongyi Palace, Empress Yingtian was called Changning Palace, Taizong was called Yongxing Palace, Shizong was called Jiqing Palace.
Taizu: Hongyi Palace; Empress Yingtian: Changning Palace; Taizong: Yongxing Palace; Shizong: Jiqing Palace.

太祖曰弘義宮 pairs each ruler with a palace orudo name; “was called Hongyi Palace” wrongly treats the palace designation as the ruler’s own name. The colon list matches the same 曰 palace-naming pattern continued in s0025.
Called called Ouliben, called Yansi, called Miansi, called Yiseng, called North Deli, and called South Deli.
Called Ouliben, called Yansi, called Miansi, called Yiseng, called North Deli, and called South Deli.
Chinese begins 曰歐裏本 with a single 曰; the doubled “Called called” is an English corruption with no source warrant.
Called called Pusuwan, called Yinian, called Woduwang, called Teman, called Moluwan, called Yidian, called Yue, and called Bodeben.
Called Pusuwan, called Yinian, called Woduwang, called Teman, called Moluwan, called Yidian, called Yue, and called Bodeben.
Chinese begins 曰蒲速碗 with a single 曰; the doubled “Called called” is an English corruption with no source warrant.
Registered-household gentlemen: At first, when Yaolian Hendejin Khan had the three clans of Puguzhi and others kill Yuyue Shilu, their families were confiscated and entered the wali.
Registered-household gentlemen: At first, when the three clans of Puguzhi and others killed Yuyue Shilu under Yaolian Hendejin Khan, their families were confiscated and entered the wali.

以蒲古只等三族害於越釋魯 names the three clans as those who harmed Yuyue Shilu; the following 籍沒家屬入瓦裏 is punishment of those killers’ households. “Had … kill” invents khan-ordered causative agency the Chinese does not state.
